additionalRules: Werewolves may benefit from the Heroic Actions and Stand Fast of friendly Wild Warg Chieftains even though they do not have the Warg keyword.
Friendly models can still pick up Objective Markers even though they have the Beast keyword.

specialRules.name: Leader of the Pack
specialRules.text: The Wild Warg Chieftain that is your General gains an additional point each of Might, Will and Fate.

specialRules.name: Feral Charge
specialRules.text: When a friendly Warg model Charges an enemy Infantry model, they gain the Knock to the Ground bonus as if they were Cavalry. This bonus is lost if they are subsequently Charged by an enemy Cavalry model.

specialRules.name: Protect the Alpha
specialRules.text: If your General has suffered at least one Wound, then friendly models treat them as a banner with a range of 6".

specialRules.name: Howl of the Wolf Pack
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, your General can declare they are using this ability. Until the End Phase of the turn, friendly models gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

units.name: Wild Warg Chieftain
options: May be taken as the Army's General - the General's version uses the same profile

specialRules.name: Packlord
specialRules.text: Friendly models may not benefit from the Heroic Actions or Stand Fast of this model unless they have the Warg keyword.

specialRules.name: Feral Charge
specialRules.text: When a Werewolf Charges an enemy Infantry model, they gain the Knock to the Ground bonus as if they were Cavalry. This bonus is lost if they are subsequently charged by an enemy Cavalry model.
